title: Optimization and validation of a micro–QuEChERS method for phthalates detection in cetacean blubber
author: Sambolino, Rodriguez, et al.

steps.title: Clean glassware and equipment
steps.instruction: Immerse all glassware in an acid bath for 24 h, then place in a muffle furnace at 550 °C overnight; use only phthalate‑free pipette tips and avoid any other plastic material.

steps.title: Prepare solvents and salts
steps.instruction: Double‑distill acetonitrile (ACN) and cyclohexane (CH) before use; wash MgSO₄, PSA, and C18 salts three times with methanol; keep all solvents (methanol, ACN, CH) at LC‑MS grade, ammonium formate ≥ 97 % purity, MgSO₄ ≥ 98 % purity (VWR International), PSA and C18 from Agilent.

steps.title: Set up procedural blanks
steps.instruction: For each batch, prepare two procedural blanks using the same reagents and glassware; later subtract the average blank value (RSD < 10 %) from sample results.

steps.title: Weigh and homogenize blubber sample
steps.instruction: Cut a 50 mg wet‑weight portion of frozen blubber, place it in a 15 mL glass tube, and mash with a glass rod while still frozen for at least 1 min.

steps.title: Extract with acetonitrile and ammonium formate
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL ACN to the frozen homogenate, vortex 1 min; then add 0.5 g ammonium formate, vortex again 1 min, and centrifuge 5 min at 2500 rpm.

steps.title: Purify extract with sorbents
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire supernatant to a clean glass tube containing 150 mg MgSO₄, 50 mg PSA, and 50 mg C18; vortex 1 min and centrifuge 5 min at 2500 rpm.

steps.title: Concentrate and reconstitute extract
steps.instruction: Pipette 200 µL of the purified supernatant into a GC vial, evaporate the solvent overnight, then reconstitute the residue in 50 µL cyclohexane.

steps.title: GC‑MS analysis of phthalates
steps.instruction: Inject 2 µL of the reconstituted extract in splitless mode (purge time 0.75 min, purge flow 40 mL min⁻¹) at 280 °C into an Agilent 6890 GC equipped with a 30 m × 0.25 mm HP‑5 ms column (0.25 µm film) coupled to an Agilent 5973 MS operating in SIM mode (ionization energy 70 eV). Oven program: start at 60 °C (hold 1 min), ramp to 190 °C at 45 °C min⁻¹, then to 310 °C at 35 °C min⁻¹, hold 3 min. Use the detection parameters described by Sambolino et al.
